name: nvidia-skill-card-validator
description: Validate a Skill Card for unresolved review markers using one fixed upstream NVIDIA script action in a bounded DGX container.

inputs.name: card
inputs.description: 待检查的 Skill Card Markdown 文本；最多 32 KiB

outputs.name: validation
outputs.description: PASS 表示没有遗留 VERIFY/SELECT 标记；不代表合规或安全认证

outputs.name: source_commit
outputs.description: 实际固定的上游 Git 提交

use_when: 按固定提交校验 NVIDIA skill-card 脚本
not_for: 通用 Skill 认证或安全合规认证
